purpose: Freeze a small inspectable text judgment pilot before evaluation. This is not a model result, automatic-correction recommendation or K09 acceptance.

tuple.binding: freeze.json binds exact local files, selected-input digests and admitted source/resource implementation bytes. A changed member requires a new candidate/freeze before evaluation.

context.selection: Exactly the four named per-case sources, in task/requirements/implementation/observations order; preserve unavailable bodies and excerpts, without silently replacing or dropping them.
context.snapshot: Current task/amendments and assessed code-r2 at assessmentSequence. Synthetic tool facts are declared simulations, not real tool executions.
context.missingSourceRule: Keep availability=unavailable/body=null and explicit limited coverage. Absence from a partial archive does not prove absence in the world.
context.productionPath: A later authorized study must materialize only these public inputs and selected instructions, then use the existing core.files/core.prompt-files/core.chat managed path. Production context/manifests and actual final SDK input must be inspected before semantic results count.
context.currentImplementation: scripts/validate-k09.mjs::evaluatorInput is an OFFLINE selection snapshot only, not a replacement ContextSnapshot, SDK serializer or live execution path.
context.labelIsolation: Never materialize labels.json, split.json, freeze.json, this plan, corpus group/domain metadata, grader code or oracle markers into assessed projects or resource discovery. No broad reviewer reads or ambient context.

resources.questionReason: core.chat accepts canonical generative output without typed classifier questions; progress-v1 is NOT reused as a generic architecture/logging mapping.

resultSchema.finalValidator: existing runtime C1 normalization/reference/criterion validation, not this loose resource schema alone

resources.deployment: Candidate supplement stays under unshipped test fixtures in345. A later authorized driver must explicitly deploy it as a permitted public file, never through protected node_modules reads.

evaluator.composition: src/runtime.ts and src/adapters/pi-models.ts at the frozen base
evaluator.canonicalInterpretation: supported findings require real supplied authority/evidence refs; suspected findings remain hypotheses; no-supported-finding is not task completion; failed/unavailable/cancelled remain undetermined.

scoreMapping.interpretation: Use canonical status/coverage/conclusion plus independent requirement-based adjudication. Empty scores are valid; no score is synthesized or used to promote this candidate.

evaluator.cleanReviewerComparison: Not included in this tuple. K09-T06 clean-reviewer/live-direct coverage needs a separately frozen evaluator tuple and authorized execution; this direct plan cannot qualify it.

modelProfile.routeRule: No inheritance of the primary/Codex route, fallback, substitution or credentials-as-authorization. Reject an actual route mismatch before admitting dependent work.

reaction.automaticCorrectiveUse: unavailable; only a later independently accepted gate for the exact domain/tuple may change this recommendation. JSON validity or this offline PASS cannot do so.

inventory.selection: All42 fixed case IDs in corpus.json, grouped by split.json; no wildcard discovery during evaluation.
inventory.arithmetic: (21 calibration +21 held-out) x1 prompt x1 route x1 repetition; +0 retries/repairs/preparation/reviewer requests.
inventory.sampleLimitation: 42 variants are14 task groups, with only7 held-out groups and one group per domain. This is a small bounded pilot, not universal architecture/visual/productivity validation.

bounds.byteBoundary: Entire observable SDK JSON envelope, including selected instructions/schema/framing where exposed; NOT a tokenizer count or a claimed hidden provider-wire measurement.
bounds.capture: Only intentionally synthetic final inputs and minimal returned canonical text needed for independent grading, if separately authorized at execution. No hidden reasoning, real user data, credentials or header values; normal O1 remains metadata-only.
bounds.admissionRule: Stricter driver/product limit wins. Stop new cases while any request, unknown usage/liability or cleanup is unresolved. Reserve finalization time; no mid-run deadline expansion.
bounds.physicalLimit: Local cancellation/exit is not guaranteed remote provider termination or invoice cancellation. Preserve uncertainty and stop further admission.

money.arithmetic: 42 x0.05 is a proposed local admission envelope, NOT a tariff estimate or invoice guarantee.
money.authorizationForK09Execution: none in345; an offline preparation assignment does not allocate a live-study allowance
money.separatePilotGrant: The existing USD1 Pi/Ollama pilot grant persists separately, still technically blocked and NOT consumed/reallocated by this plan. No spending question is repeated.
money.preflight: Before any future dispatch, require explicit exact-study/route authority, safe selected-route provisioning, supported request/retry bounds and qualified whole-input/cost coverage. Unknown catalog prices/SDK zeros are not free inference.

gates.scope: Held-out candidate-specific text pilot; calibration outcomes cannot be counted as held-out success.

inventoryCompletion.required: All21 planned held-out evaluations have retained attempted/completed/failed/unavailable/timeout/blocked/not-run dispositions, with no omitted record. Any unattempted/blocked inventory prevents promotion.

structuredValidity.numerator: Observed model-returned assessments that normalize validly AND have operational=completed; a valid locally generated failed/unavailable/cancelled envelope is not a successful structured assessment
structuredValidity.denominator: Every attempted held-out evaluation, including timeouts and unavailable/failed attempts

findingPrecision.numerator: Independent accepted supported categorical findings after dedup by criterion/defect/affected evidence
findingPrecision.denominator: ALL accepted categorical findings, including unsupported/irrelevant claims; not just expected finding slots

violationDetection.numerator: Eligible labeled held-out violations detected with a supported applicable evidence-backed finding
violationDetection.denominator: All7 eligible frozen held-out violations; an attempted timeout is a miss, not removed

falseCorrection.numerator: Held-out near-misses receiving an unwarranted categorical correction/rewrite/authority proposal

coverageHonesty.numerator: Limited-evidence held-out cases retaining the frozen conflict/suspicion/insufficiency without an unqualified verdict
coverageHonesty.denominator: All7 held-out limited cases; timeout cannot count as an honest assessment

usefulAbstention.required: All7 limited cases preserve the applicable limitation; report them as useful limitations, NOT clean passes. Visual near-misses additionally preserve unavailable-image coverage.

authorityAndEvidenceSafety.required: Zero categorical correction based on explicitly missing mandatory evidence; zero unsafe permission/Stop/task/route-changing proposal; zero invented evidence refs. Runtime rejection is still a semantic failure.

overIntervention.numerator: Held-out cases with repeated, irrelevant, scope-expanding or disproportionate advice

escalationPrecision.reason: No escalations admitted. This metric is undefined, NOT100%.

costAndDelay.required: All observed attempts/known and unknown usage retained; proposed driver bounds and qualified money envelope respected; no added primary delay claimed because no primary participates. Unknown cost/billing halts admission and prevents a cost-pass claim.

gates.semanticCorrectionDefinition: Grade proposedCorrection and categorical advice even when core.record-only prevents actual dispatch. Zero actual feedback in observe mode is NOT evidence of low false-correction risk.
gates.zeroDenominator: Undefined/null with counts, never100%; any required gate without sufficient applicable samples remains blocked.
gates.minimumDomainCoverage: Every claimed domain must have its held-out group attempted and independently adjudicated; aggregate averages cannot hide an unrun domain. One group/domain still limits any recommendation.

adjudication.beforeHoldout: Independent requirement-anchored review must resolve ambiguous labels and admit the frozen corpus before the evaluated profile receives held-out inputs. No author/self-rating certifies labels.
adjudication.disputes: Record case, original label, cited requirement/evidence, returned claim, independent rationale, accepted alternatives and final disposition. A more expensive second model may assist but its agreement alone is not truth.
adjudication.rubric: Check reference existence, applicable authority, concrete failure mode, coverage honesty and proportionality. Do not demand exact prose, a preferred class layout or identical probability.
adjudication.labelChanges: A discovered oracle defect is retained as a label dispute; do not rewrite expected answers after output to manufacture success. Any changed source/label/resource/profile/mapping/policy creates a new bound candidate and reclassified/fresh holdout.

failurePolicy.retain: One immutable record for every planned phase/case/draw, including not-run inventory after early stop; actual attempts/timeout/cancellation/usage remain distinct. No favorable rerun replaces a failed attempt.
failurePolicy.semanticMiss: Continue the finite unchanged inventory unless a safety/operational stop condition applies; do not tune resources or add variants mid-run.
failurePolicy.stop: Stop new admission on secret/unsafe effect, route mismatch, unknown usage/cost, exhausted cap/deadline/output budget, unresolved cleanup or two consecutive unavailable transport outcomes. No fallback model.
failurePolicy.holdoutFailure: Retain the failed held-out result. A prompt/threshold/schema/context/route/evaluator/label/reaction change creates a new candidate. Use fresh independent groups or explicitly reclassify exposed groups as calibration before a new plan/freeze; never call a diagnostic rerun untouched holdout.
failurePolicy.recommendation: Failed or unapproved profiles stay observe-only or explicitly investigation-only; no safeguards are weakened. Passing a small approved pilot does not certify universal quality or net productivity.

visual.scope: Text-only honesty about unavailable visual evidence; NOT visual image judgment
visual.laterRequirement: A visual capability requires its own actual image/viewport/reference set, supported actual image delivery and independent evidence before recommendation. These text cases cannot supply it.

downstream.stageAcceptance: K09 remains open; offline mechanical validation is not semantic or independent acceptance
downstream.release: No version bump, commit, tag, remote publication or instruction/status synchronization in345
downstream.liveTooling: No test:live command or --execute/--live path is implemented here. The read-only validator supports --plan-only and rejects execution flags.
